subject: Web Development
title: Tailwind and the Utility-First Movement
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Tailwind and the Utility-First Movement.

hook.text: CSS frameworks like Bootstrap gave you pre-built components. Tailwind took a different path.

buildup.text: Tailwind provides tiny utility classes: 'p-4' for padding, 'text-red-500' for color.

discovery.text: Instead of writing CSS files, you compose styles directly in your HTML class names.

twist.text: Critics said Tailwind was just inline styles with extra steps. Fans said it was pure speed.

climax.text: Tailwind became one of the most popular CSS tools by betting that colocation beats separation.

punchline.text: Putting styles in markup became mainstream again.

quiz.question: What approach does Tailwind CSS use?
